items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Paul Gaten was very popular, Anna Laura was singing. Singing. And she was very popular, and you know, it just drew its people.

ctx.x: Well how did the club like the Robin Hood, how did it differ from the city Dewdrop or the Starlight or?

Well the Robin Hood, Paul Gaten was playing at the Robin Hood. See, so this was before Paul Gaten went on Canal Street. And Paul Gaten was very popular, Anna Laura was singing. Singing. And she was very popular, and you know, it just drew its people. Well back then, all the night clubs drew their people then. You see the Robin Hood would be full, and you go around down to Dewdrop, they was full. You know, Armstead's Bar, they had a club right there on Jackson Avenue, what, two blocks from Claiborne, you know,…
You think that's the reason people don't go out?
